title: National AI Strategy Committee
summary: Presidential committee chaired by President Lee Jae-myung that sets national AI strategy, coordinates ministries' AI programmes and monitors implementation, with the goal of making Korea one of the world's top three AI powers (AI G3). It was launched on 8 September 2025 under a presidential decree in force from 4 September 2025, expanding the National AI Committee set up in September 2024. Since 22 January 2026 it has been a statutory body under Article 7 of the AI Basic Act. It has eight subcommittees and a council of ministries' Chief AI Officers, and adopted the AI Action Plan in February 2026.
beneficiaries: Government ministries; private-sector members advise across eight subcommittees
